title: The Problem With unavailable_after - Google Might Not See Updated Dates
summary: Google supports the unavailable_after meta attribute, which will tell Google not to show this page in search results after the specified date/time.  The problem with this, is that if you try to change the unavailable_after date later, Google might not pick up on it because Google may not try to crawl that page before the last given date.

title: Bing Testing Pricing On Product Images
summary: Microsoft seems to be testing showing pricing on the product images within the Bing Search organic results.  Normally, Bing would show review stars on the product images and, below the image, show the price. I should note that I am also seeing two rows of products under a single search result snippet, which I think is new.

title: Google Ads Target CPA & Target ROAS As Explicit Bidding Strategy Options

We knew this was coming, as it is supported in the new version of Google Ads Editor 2.13 and all the other recent communication from Google and now advertisers are seeing it.

title: Google Search Doesn't Publish Precedence For Metadata In Conflict
summary: Google's John Mueller confirmed it has not and likely won't publish publicly Google Search's defined order of precedence for metadata reconciliation. In other words, if you have conflicting signals you are sending Google, which signal trumps the other. Like a 301 redirect from URL A to URL B but on URL B, you have a canonical tag to URL A, which should Google trust.
